question.problem:
| $f$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=5$ | $Y=10$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0$ | $\frac{3}{16}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
| $X=2$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $0$ | $\frac{5}{16}$ |
| $X=4$ | $\frac{3}{16}$ | $0$ | $\frac{1}{16}$ |

Compute $P(0\le Y<10\,|\,X=4)$ given that the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
question.worked_solution:
By the multiplication law for conditional probability, the required conditional probability is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}P(0\le Y<10\,|\,X=4) & =\frac{P((0\le Y<10),X=4)}{P(X=4)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=4,(0\le Y<10))}{P(X=4)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=4,Y=0)+P(X=4,Y=5)}{P(X=4)} \\  & =\frac{f(4,0)+f(4,5)}{{f}_{X}(4)},\end{aligned}
$$

where $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability mass function of $X$ and $Y,$ and ${f}_{X}(x)$ is the marginal distribution of $X.$

Recall that the marginal distribution for $X$ corresponds to the row totals. Thus,

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(4) & =f(4,0)+f(4,5)+f(4,10) \\  & =\frac{3}{16}+0+\frac{1}{16} \\  & =\frac{1}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the given table, we have that $f(4,0)=\frac{3}{16}$ and $f(4,5)=0.$ 

Finally, substituting our values into our formula above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}P(0\le Y<10\,|\,X=4) & =\frac{f(4,0)+f(4,5)}{{f}_{X}(4)} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{3}{16}+0)}{(\frac{1}{4})} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{3}{16})}{(\frac{1}{4})} \\  & =\frac{3}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
